heroDesc: Choose which slides appear, tune them one by one and set the slideshow behaviour.
marqueeDesc: What scrolls is chosen here: partner logos, news, events, job offers, products, a mix of those modules, or blocks written in the studio. Title optional, margins and item size configurable.
navigationDesc: Navigation tiles (solutions, services, products, events, news, careers).
missionDesc: Text band over a background image with a button — texts, style and page builder.
productsDesc: Title, description, number of products and which cards to feature.
blocksDesc: Alternating image / text blocks: add, edit, or hand the block over to the page builder.
statsDesc: Values and labels edited directly inside the block.
testimonialsDesc: Pick the testimonials, set the images and order them.
eventsDesc: Which events appear on the home page, and in which order.
newsDesc: Which articles appear on the home page, and in which order.
newsletterDesc: Block texts and real address sign-up (the list lives in Newsletter).
partnersDesc: Which partners are featured on the home page.
ctaDesc: The “Ready to start your project?” block: texts, buttons and colours, language by language.
